resolved_by: Amendments to Fed. R. Crim. P. 32.1 effective 2005, which incorporated the Rule 32 allocution requirements into revocation and modification hearings
issue: Does a defendant's right of allocution under Rule 32 extend to supervised-release revocation sentencing, such that the opportunity to speak must come before the sentence is imposed?
quote: The Advisory Committee Notes to the 2005 Amendments addressed a circuit split over whether the Rule 32 allocution requirements should be incorporated into Rule 32.1
cite: United States v. Sylvan Abney, 957 F.3d 241 (D.C. Cir. 2020)
